# The Daily Table

> A free meal planner, pantry-to-recipe matcher and grocery list that needs no account. It holds 84 measured recipes (28 adapted from a public recipe collection, 56 original editorial ideas), four editable weekly menus, a photo-assisted ingredient finder and a shopping list. Everything a visitor saves stays in their own browser. No calorie, nutrient or medical claims are made.

## Key pages
- [Recipes](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/recipes/): all 84 recipes with search, meal and time filters
- [My pantry](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/pantry/): choose ingredients, or confirm foods recognised from a photo, to see matching recipes, what is missing and what to use first
- [Meal plan](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/weekly-plan/): four weekly menus, editable, with a one-tap week builder that follows saved diet, time and ingredient-exclusion preferences
- [Shopping list](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/shopping-list/): one grouped list built from the chosen week, with quantities scaled to the portions selected
- [How it works](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/how-it-works/): choose the ingredients you have, shape your week, shop from one organized list and track today on this device.

## Publisher
- [GearUpToFit](https://gearuptofit.com/): the site that publishes The Daily Table. It also hosts [nutrition guides](https://gearuptofit.com/nutrition/) and [fitness calculators](https://gearuptofit.com/calculators/).

## Sources, standards and limits
- [About: sources and standards](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/about/): How The Daily Table was built: where recipe identities came from, what was editorially adapted, what is not claimed and how photographs are used.
- [Privacy and food safety](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/privacy/): What The Daily Table stores on your device, what leaves your browser, how optional photo recognition works and the food-safety limits of its recipes.
- [Photo credits](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/photo-credits/): each recipe photograph is credited to its photographer with its open licence and original page (84 of 84 recipes have one)

## Guides
- [Recipe matching](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/guides/recipe-matching/): how recipes are matched to the foods a person has, and why nothing is substituted silently
- [Cook from your pantry](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/guides/cook-from-your-pantry/): How to cook from what you already have: select pantry ingredient names, read the match score honestly and use first the foods you marked.
- [Meal planning](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/guides/meal-planning/): A practical meal-planning guide: plan the meals that need a decision, pick a realistic starting menu and build a shopping list from your pantry.
- [Photo recognition](https://daily-table.gearuptofit.com/guides/photo-recognition/): How optional photo ingredient recognition works: choose a clear photo, correct each suggested food, confirm what you recognize and what a photo cannot show.

## Facts that can be cited
- Each recipe lists ingredients with measured amounts for one reference portion and a numbered method. Amounts scale in the app; cooking times do not.
- Times are editorial estimates, not tested totals. The recipes have not been independently kitchen-tested.
- Safe-temperature guidance links to FoodSafety.gov: 74 C / 165 F for poultry, 71 C / 160 F for ground meat and egg dishes, 63 C / 145 F for fish and shrimp.
- Photographs show a similar dish, are hosted on this site, and are used under open licences (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA) with credit. They are not evidence of testing or allergen suitability.
- Optional photo ingredient recognition needs explicit consent. Its suggestions are reviewed by the person before anything is saved, and the app does not store the photo.
- Diet and ingredient filters only exclude named ingredients. They do not check labels, cross-contact or medical suitability.

## Version 8 kitchen planning
The 84 existing catalog recipes and four original menus are retained. A local, deterministic composer provides 11 ingredient-validated kitchen templates using only selected supported food IDs. New kitchen recipes are explicitly labeled and noindex; they are not independently kitchen-tested or clinical nutrition prescriptions. Optional local profiles set portions, food exclusions, ingredient style and time. Thirteen photographs are labeled serving inspiration; all 84 recipes have precise ingredient illustrations, not purported exact cooked-dish photos. Photo analysis requires explicit consent and human review.
